import { h, replace } from "/src/ui/dom.ts";
import { questBar, rewardPicture } from "/src/ui/quest.ts";
import "/src/journal.css";
/** Completed milestones may still open an earned system; completion never repeats a purchase. */
export const journalActionAllowed = (entry) => !!entry.action?.enabled && (entry.state !== "complete" || entry.action.kind === "open");
/** Rust supplies all objectives and rewards. Callbacks route existing real actions. */
export function createJournal(options) {
	const el = h("div", { class: "sheet-body journal-panel" });
	const status = h("p", {
		class: "journal-status",
		role: "status",
		"aria-live": "polite",
		tabindex: -1
	});
	let identity;
	let revision = 0;
	let disposed = false;
	let busy = false;
	let fingerprint = "";
	const open = new Map();
	const run = async (key, operation, expected) => {
		if (busy || disposed) return;
		if (expected !== identity) return;
		busy = true;
		el.setAttribute("aria-busy", "true");
		for (const button of el.querySelectorAll("button")) button.disabled = true;
		let ok = false;
		try {
			// Re-read before routing: detached controls cannot target a different hero.
			const before = await options.read();
			if (!disposed && before.identity === expected) ok = await operation(before);
		} catch {
			ok = false;
		} finally {
			busy = false;
			el.removeAttribute("aria-busy");
			await refresh(true);
		}
		if (!disposed && identity === expected) {
			status.textContent = ok ? "Updated" : /* copy:callout */ "Action refused";
			const available = (node) => node.getClientRects().length > 0 && !(node instanceof HTMLButtonElement && node.disabled);
			const keyed = [...el.querySelectorAll("[data-journal-focus]")].find((node) => node.dataset.journalFocus === key && available(node));
			const recommended = [...el.querySelectorAll("[data-recommended=\"true\"] button")].find(available);
			const chapter = [...el.querySelectorAll(".journal-chapter > summary")].find(available);
			(keyed ?? recommended ?? chapter ?? status).focus({ preventScroll: true });
		}
	};
	const entry = (item, recommended = false) => {
		const owner = identity;
		const progress = item.progress;
		const action = item.action;
		const card = h("article", {
			class: "journal-step",
			"data-entry-id": item.id,
			"data-state": item.state,
			"data-recommended": String(recommended)
		}, recommended ? h(
			"small",
			{},
			/* copy:label */
			"Next"
		) : null, h("h3", {}, item.title), h("p", {}, item.reason), h("p", {}, item.effect), progress ? h("div", {}, h("progress", {
			max: Math.max(1, progress.required),
			value: progress.current,
			"aria-label": item.title
		}), h("small", { class: "num" }, `${progress.current}/${progress.required} ${progress.unit}`)) : null, ...item.requirements.map((requirement) => h("small", {}, requirement)));
		if (item.state === "complete") card.append(h(
			"small",
			{},
			/* copy:label */
			"Complete"
		));
		if (action && (item.state !== "complete" || action.kind === "open")) {
			const key = `action:${item.id}`;
			card.append(h("div", { class: "journal-actions" }, h("button", {
				class: "btn",
				disabled: !action.enabled || busy,
				"data-journal-focus": key,
				onclick: () => void run(key, async (snapshot) => {
					const current = snapshot.journal.chapters.flatMap((chapter) => chapter.entries).find((candidate) => candidate.id === item.id);
					return current?.action && journalActionAllowed(current) ? options.action(current.action, current.id) : false;
				}, owner)
			}, action.label)));
			if (action.blocked) card.append(h("small", {}, action.blocked));
		}
		return card;
	};
	const fold = (id, title, content) => {
		const details = h("details", {
			class: "journal-chapter",
			"data-chapter": id,
			open: open.get(id) ?? false
		}, h("summary", { "data-journal-focus": `chapter:${id}` }, title), h("div", { class: "journal-entries" }, ...content));
		details.addEventListener("toggle", () => open.set(id, details.open));
		return details;
	};
	async function refresh(force = false) {
		if (disposed) return;
		const ticket = ++revision;
		const snapshot = await options.read();
		if (disposed || ticket !== revision) return;
		const model = snapshot.journal;
		const next = JSON.stringify(snapshot);
		if (!force && next === fingerprint) return;
		const same = identity === snapshot.identity;
		const scrollNode = el.closest(".game-window, .sheet") ?? el;
		const scroll = same ? scrollNode.scrollTop : 0;
		const active = document.activeElement;
		const focused = same && active && el.contains(active) ? active.dataset.journalFocus : undefined;
		if (same) {
			for (const details of el.querySelectorAll("details[data-chapter]")) open.set(details.dataset.chapter, details.open);
		}
		if (!same) {
			open.clear();
			status.textContent = "";
		}
		identity = snapshot.identity;
		fingerprint = next;
		const recommended = model.chapters.flatMap((chapter) => chapter.entries).find((item) => item.id === model.recommended && (item.state !== "complete" || journalActionAllowed(item)));
		const children = [h(
			"h2",
			{ class: "journal-heading" },
			/* copy:label */
			"Journal"
		)];
		if (recommended) children.push(entry(recommended, true));
		for (const chapter of model.chapters) {
			const remaining = chapter.entries.filter((item) => item.id !== recommended?.id);
			if (!remaining.length) continue;
			const available = remaining.filter((item) => item.state !== "later");
			const later = remaining.filter((item) => item.state === "later");
			children.push(fold(chapter.id, chapter.title, [...available.map((item) => entry(item)), ...later.length ? [fold(
				`${chapter.id}:later`,
				/* copy:label */
				"Later",
				later.map((item) => entry(item))
			)] : []]));
		}
		const q = model.quest;
		if (q) {
			const quest = h("article", { class: `journal-step quest-card${q.done ? " done" : ""}` }, h(
				"h3",
				{},
				/* copy:label */
				"Quest"
			), rewardPicture(q.reward), h("div", { class: "quest-main" }, h("b", { class: "quest-goal" }, q.goal), h("p", {}, q.body), questBar(q), h("small", { class: "num" }, `${Math.round((q.done ? 1 : q.progress) * 100)}%`)), q.done ? h(
				"small",
				{},
				/* copy:label */
				"Complete"
			) : null);
			if (!q.done && options.swapQuest) {
				quest.append(h("button", {
					class: "btn",
					disabled: !q.swap || busy,
					"data-journal-focus": "quest:swap",
					onclick: () => void run("quest:swap", async (snapshot) => snapshot.journal.quest?.swap && !snapshot.journal.quest.done ? options.swapQuest() : false, snapshot.identity)
				}, q.swap ? "Swap" : /* copy:callout */ "Swapped today"));
			}
			children.push(quest);
		}
		if (model.discoveries.length) children.push(fold(
			"discoveries",
			/* copy:label */
			"Discoveries",
			model.discoveries.map((item) => h("article", {
				class: "journal-discovery",
				"data-discovery-id": item.id
			}, h("strong", {}, item.title), h("p", {}, item.body)))
		));
		replace(el, ...children, status);
		scrollNode.scrollTop = scroll;
		if (focused) [...el.querySelectorAll("[data-journal-focus]")].find((node) => node.dataset.journalFocus === focused)?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
	}
	return {
		el,
		refresh,
		dispose() {
			disposed = true;
			++revision;
		}
	};
}
